author: Turkey Tom
description:
Few people in the history of social media have exploded as fast as Clavicular, real name Braden Peters. But history dictates that the harder they come , the harder they go. His breakout story was inspiring: a kid from an obscure self-improvement forum managed to monetize his ascension and turn into a celebrity overnight. However, while he took off, he made every effort to paint himself as someone whose sole interest was to become the best version of himself, all while broadcasting the dark toll it took on his health and well-being. From a long list of substances that he gradually became dependent on, to broken relationships with his family and friends and the increasing amount of effort it took for him to maintain his popularity, Clav became a shell of his former self. Even his looks, which were originally his first priorty, are clearly falling apart as he skeletonizes himself for content. Not to mention his never-ending list of legal issues.

Hope you enjoy the vid.
